module.purpose: Provides a Deferred type and factory function for creating controllable Promise objects that can be resolved or rejected from outside the Promise constructor scope.
module.summary: This file defines a Deferred<T> interface and a createDeferred<T>() factory function. The Deferred interface wraps a Promise with external resolve/reject controls and a pending status check, enabling Promise resolution from outside the constructor scope. The factory function creates the Deferred by capturing resolve/reject callbacks within a Promise executor and returning an object that exposes these controls along with the promise and a pending state flag.
module.businessContext: Enables explicit external control over Promise lifecycle, critical for database transactions, async event handling, and complex asynchronous workflows where resolution depends on external events or conditions.
functions: createDeferred<T> (~L24-47): Creates a Deferred object with externally controllable Promise
